spatial-index-poc.scope: Desktop JVM AABB broad phase only; synthetic ink subset; no exact hit test, render, device latency or heap measurement

brush-path-costs.scope: Desktop JVM one pass per brush, 100 initial warmup strokes. Build timings exclude fixture IO/sample copying, include output allocation and possible GC. Outputs released per stroke. No wall-clock threshold.

brush-reduction-costs.scope: Same-process desktop JVM comparison, alternating baseline/reduced order; 100 warmups then one pass. Reduced build includes plan and projection copies, both exclude fixture IO/canonical sample creation. Logical payloads, not actual heap. No time threshold.

chunked-brush-costs.scope: Desktop JVM exploratory cold costs, bounded CPU subpixel reference rasterization, S9 per-stroke window work and S2 global bounds-only index experiment. No native raster/heap, page UI, frame budget or latency acceptance.

brush-tile-cache-costs.scope: JVM synthetic viewport trace; logical packed CPU-mask accounting only

android-brush-common-tests.scope: Real ART execution of original primitive input arena/replay plus common geometry/reduction/chunk index/subpixel mask tests in an isolated test-only library APK. Includes actual Android Bitmap/Canvas premultiplication, color/alpha and nearest and filtered tile seam checks with true neighbor gutter and disjoint device-pixel core clips. Includes Bitmap allocationByteCount observations; no whole-process heap, GPU, arbitrary transform, app UI, touch or device performance claim.

apple-brush-common-tests.scope: Actual common primitive input arena/replay, envelope/path generation, bounded admission, cancellation and coverage tests compiled/run by Kotlin/Native. Includes CoreGraphics RGBA image/alpha/color and nearest/filtered tile consumption. No UIKit touch, physical performance, general filter/transform or heap claim.

ios-host-tests.scope: Actual iOS app-host APIs, isolated temporary files and CoreGraphics offscreen pixels. Separate test build; not distributable binary UI, real touch, system picker, force-stop or power-loss recovery evidence.

render-viewport-trace.scope: Same fixed synthetic scroll/zoom responsibility trace on actual ART Bitmap and iOS app-host Swift worker/CGImage; no ordinary app integration. Timings are single exploratory runs with deliberate worker gate/owner polling. Wait bounds bracket admission within submit and end at beforeCompute; include handoff overhead, not isolated scheduler latency. Row storage/charge is not peak heap or GPU residency.

canonical-title-contract.scope: Direct document authority commands on JVM/ART/Kotlin Native, plus Android isolated real file-port UTF-8 write/reopen and old-file preservation. Native test uses malformed UTF-16 literals before Objective-C bridging. No new schema, persistence backend, production storage or full App UI acceptance.

public-boundary-inventory.scope: Inventory of retained source-bound iOS Simulator compiler header, including compiler support/generated methods. NSError declaration is structural evidence only: no claim that every thrown exception or callback is caught. Methods with no NSError may return typed failures or trap on precondition/owner/index violations. No API surface is approved by this count.

preview-edit-contract.scope: Original preview edit requests on JVM/ART/Kotlin Native. Android checks use synthetic in-memory roots and preserve old files; real model/file-port integration is separately verified by iOS app-host. No new authority, format, production store or ordinary UI acceptance.

preview-input-contract.scope: Actual JVM/Kotlin Native raw-batch tests plus source-bound Android original View synthetic MotionEvents and iOS original UIKit callbacks/NSData bridge app-host tests. No ordinary package UI, real OS stylus delivery or physical latency claim. Source byte/count bounds are not measured process heap or a production arena.

ios-preview-ui.scope: Selected ordinary UIKit simulator UI on current 4c7f78dd package, manually observed through CUA, staged native document bytes and PID-specific provider logs. No host test rerun or physical-device acceptance.

input-capture-contract.scope: Synthetic draft capture-file validation, not native adapter collection, runtime replay or device acceptance.

apple-current-revalidation.scope: Current integrated source built and executed on dedicated iOS Simulator. Native111, actual app-host36, ordinary package restored and original76 files preserved. Not current ordinary UI, Android runtime, physical input/heap or full C1 evidence recovery.

android-input-host-tests.scope: Synthetic native MotionEvent history and terminal batches delivered directly to the original InkCanvasView callback on Android main thread; canonical notebook stays in memory. Oracle uses actual SDK-exposed event scalars, then double scene mapping. Not injected OS events, ordinary UI or physical stylus evidence.

android-render-integration.scope: Actual original Android app-host hierarchy consumes complete compositor frames and active/static replacement, page/zoom, source release/fence, detach/late ACK, cleanup UNKNOWN, actual-receipt recovery after injected post-handoff confirmation loss, delayed owner settlement/backpressure/shared storage and saved new-owner reopen. Ordinary code is connected, but no ordinary-process UI acceptance. No physical stylus/frame/heap, production GPU backend, C1 or SQLite claim.

sqlite-platform-capabilities.scope: Synthetic state/operation atomicity, actual writer SIGKILL before commit/after commit before receipt/after receipt, replay/conflict/stale rejection, transaction and DDL/version rollback, SQLite max_page_count FULL, read-only unknown schema/corruption refusal. Platform-specific probes are test-only and are not shared-data or App owner integration.

incremental-spatial-index.scope: Derived immutable STR base plus bounded replacement/tombstone overlay, complete-or-rejected bbox queries, atomic delta admission and compaction content publication contract. Actual JVM, ART and Kotlin/Native library tests. Not a production spatial adapter or a second Scene authority.

pdf-platform-capabilities.scope: Four synthetic rotations/crop-offset color anchors, native full/tile PNGs and independent marker oracle, guarded-core versus whole-page comparison, test-only RC4-128 password/missing/wrong password, malformed/read-only input, native text/outline capability and selected first/last render requests from a simple 500-page file. No user PDF or production resource/import/task protocol.

scope: Read-only rehash of recorded inputs and retained artifacts; no rerun or completeness proof. Historical drift is explicit, never promoted to current benchmark evidence. Current binding failure blocks this audit. Decisions remain in ADR-0020 and C1未决事项.md.
